intent: U19, the review's P3 batch: seven things that cost a click or a screen. The missions board started 500px below the templates; two empty pages kept their one action in a header; Settings' section list ran off a phone's edge; the sessions strip took a phone screen; Logs' header actions wrapped onto three rows; Composer shipped its canvas on the Run tab; and Composer's launch control read 'Review…'. Six are done here. The seventh is an operator ruling of 2026-08-26 and stays as ruled.

invariants: I1 THE BOARD COMES FIRST. Missions' templates are a collapsed CollapsibleSection that says its count; the board is under the filters; an empty board's EmptyState carries New Mission and Load a template, and the latter opens the disclosure.
I2 AN EMPTY PAGE OFFERS ITS ACTION, ON THE PRIMITIVE. Automation's and Artifacts' empty states are EmptyState with an action; no page draws its own dashed box.
I3 A PHONE JUMPS BY A SELECT. Below lg Settings' nav is the ui InlineSelect 'Jump to section', which sets the hash; the link list is hidden below lg and the pages stay reachable as links.
I4 A STRIP IS ONE ROW ON A PHONE. StatStrip renders strip-phone-row (sm:hidden) from the same props and hides its donut, tiles and ring below sm.
I5 THE TERMINAL OWNS ITS BAR. LogTerminal carries the Auto-refresh switch (InlineToggle) and Lines to show (InlineSelect); LogsHeaderActions keeps Refresh and Delete All; no decoration dots.
I6 THE CANVAS WAITS FOR BUILD. WorkflowCanvas mounts once Build has been opened and stays mounted after.
